description: Offre de transports urbain du réseau Amelys (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agglomération Montargoise. GFTS file allowing to obtain the stops, schedules and circuits of the lines of the Amelys network, public transport service delegate of the Montargoise Agglomeration (15 municipalities). \[File update in June 2025] File available until July 2026. Coverage: Agglomération Montargoise. The portal shows the English title as "Urban transport offer of the Amelys network (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agglomération Montargoise. Its keywords include amelys, lombreuil, saint-maurice-sur-fessard, montargis, chevillon-sur-huillard, paucourt. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
